title: Arabic prompt: number of days in a week
rationale: Arabic-language users often get English or transliterated output for simple numeric questions; a wrong day count in Arabic breaks calendar features in localized apps.

prompt.content: أنت مساعد دقيق. أجب باللغة العربية بجملة قصيرة واحدة فقط، دون أي شرح.

notes: Language: Arabic. Expected answer token: 7, accepted as the ASCII digit 7, the Arabic-Indic digit ٧, the word forms سبعة/سبعه/سبع, or the English word seven, so a legitimate rendering is never scored as a failure. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: fully diacritized Arabic (for example with vowel marks inside the word) is not matched by the word branch, though an answer containing the digit still passes.
